title: Distance-Guided Search in Program Synthesis with Imperfect LLM Solutions
summary: The original GuideSyn pipeline uses distance-guided search seeded by LLM-generated programs, iteratively refining imperfect solutions through a type-directed program synthesis engine (Trio) to solve ML-like functional benchmark problems.
This reproduction replaces the distance-guided synthesis loop with a direct functional program generation prompt, evaluating correctness via Trio on the full benchmark set.
metric: % solved (LLM output passes Trio correctness check)
